policy: Options-only proposal. Preserve item IDs, option IDs/order, keys, prompts and audio. Never import this review artifact into the app before academic approval.

options: She left after the afternoon lecture ended.
It's beside the library, in the next building.
No, I usually get coffee near campus.
The soup stays warm in that covered pot.
items.rationale: B conserva la ubicación; los distractores mantienen funciones distintas con siluetas comparables.

items.rationale: A conserva la disponibilidad solicitada; las alternativas permanecen temáticamente cercanas pero no contestan la pregunta.

The document you sent contains three large images.
I may have missed it; I'll resend the email now.

options: She failed to submit the project before its deadline.
She wants the professor to move her into another group.
She cannot understand what the assignment requires from her.
Two group members are not contributing to the project.
items.rationale: D conserva el problema central; los distractores son interpretaciones completas y plausibles.

options: Assign the two members specific tasks and deadlines.
Complete the remaining group work entirely by herself.
Withdraw from the course before the next class meeting.
Report both group members directly to the college dean.
items.rationale: A resume el primer paso indicado sin añadir detalle innecesario.

options: Stop working on the project and accept a lower grade.
Return with records of her attempts to contact them.
Discuss the unhelpful members with students outside the group.
Rewrite the entire group project without telling the professor.
items.rationale: B conserva la acción condicional; las alternativas siguen siendo claramente distintas.

options: Through one final examination taken by the entire group.
Through a single shared mark with no individual adjustment.
Through peer evaluations that may affect individual grades.
Through identical grades assigned to every group member.
items.rationale: C conserva el mecanismo de evaluación individual; se equilibran las formulaciones.

options: A temporary change to the schedule of several classes
The planned closure of a gallery on the campus
A concert featuring music performed by current students
A student art contest based on the theme ‘Home’

options: A brief note explaining what the artwork means to them
A recent photograph showing the student beside the artwork
A detailed essay discussing the history of the chosen medium
A receipt confirming payment of the competition entry fee
items.rationale: A conserva el requisito; los distractores son adjuntos plausibles pero no mencionados.

options: A technique for increasing reading speed during examinations
A study method based on reviewing material only once
Better memory from spreading study across multiple sessions
A procedure for measuring a learner's general intelligence
items.rationale: C conserva la definición y elimina la explicación redundante que delataba la clave.

options: Both schedules produce the same amount of long-term retention.
Neither schedule produces useful learning after the final session.
Studying for six hours on the night before the test.
Studying one hour daily over a period of six days.
items.rationale: D conserva el ejemplo espaciado; las alternativas presentan comparaciones completas.

options: Because effortful retrieval after a delay strengthens memory.
Because spaced practice always feels more enjoyable to students.
Because cramming cannot be used for difficult academic material.
Because spaced sessions require less total study time overall.
items.rationale: A conserva la explicación causal; las alternativas ofrecen causas plausibles de extensión similar.

options: The material becomes too complex to understand after one session.
Easy recall provides too little effort to strengthen memory.
Students become too tired to remember any recently studied material.
A single session always requires substantially more total study time.
items.rationale: B conserva el contraste entre recuerdo fácil y fortalecimiento; se acorta sin perder la relación causal.

options: The dining hall serves lunch until early afternoon.
The housing office manages requests for those changes.
I changed trains at the downtown station yesterday.
Your meal looks especially delicious this afternoon.
items.rationale: B conserva la oficina responsable; los distractores mantienen extensión comparable.

The complete forecast is shown on local television.

Register immediately for a different workshop offered next month.

Pay in advance to reserve places in both sessions.

options: At the bookstore's main entrance near the information desk
At the library circulation desk on the ground floor
At the campus mailroom beside the administration building
At a temporary collection counter inside West Hall

options: Processes that stabilize and reorganize newly formed memories
A method that prevents all information from being forgotten
Conscious review that can occur only while someone is awake
The immediate perception and registration of unfamiliar information
items.rationale: A conserva la definición; se equilibran las definiciones alternativas.

options: To ensure that every participant experiences a memorable dream
To prevent participants from learning the assigned task beforehand
Because those factors could otherwise explain differences in performance
Because those factors determine the exact content of every memory
items.rationale: C conserva la amenaza de confusión experimental; D sigue siendo ligeramente más extensa.

options: Participants learn the experimental task only after waking up.
Researchers deliberately erase one selected memory during sleep.
A cue produces a completely new memory while participants sleep.
A cue from earlier learning is presented while participants sleep.
items.rationale: D conserva el procedimiento; C ofrece una alternativa paralela de longitud comparable.

options: Sleep stores every experience exactly as it originally occurred.
Sleep is an active state capable of influencing memory.
Sleep matters primarily because it reduces physical fatigue.
Sleep can completely replace repeated practice during learning.
items.rationale: B conserva la conclusión principal; las cuatro opciones comparten estructura y longitud.
